title.es: Aquel en el que Fina pide perdón
title.en: The One Where Fina Asks for Forgiveness

description.es: Digna nota que Marta evita a Fina, y Fina le confiesa que ya le contó la verdad sobre Bianca y que se siente culpable por haberla engañado. Más tarde, Fina se encuentra con Marta en un café, le pide perdón y le asegura que, aunque dejará la casa grande, se quedará en Toledo por ella y porque está dispuesta a olvidar a Bianca.
description.en: Digna notices that Marta is avoiding Fina, and Fina confesses that she has already told her the truth about Bianca and that she feels guilty for having deceived her. Later, Fina meets Marta at a café, asks for her forgiveness, and assures her that, although she will leave the big house, she will stay in Toledo for her, and because she is willing to forget Bianca.
